By continuing, you agree to Yelp’s Terms of Service and acknowledge Yelp’s Privacy Policy. How anyone could give less than five stars is beyond me. This is a quick little visit to the Bandai company to see their Character Street. They also have some exhibits inside relating to their products from cartoons, toys etc. If you need a quick 10 to 30 minute activity whether you're alone or with your family this is a fun little thing to do. Many of the Bandai characters are lined up outside. Large statues that you can take your photos with. Inside, as I mentioned, are a few other items to see, and it doesn't cost any money to go in. You could visit this as you walk from the Asakusa area on your way to perhaps the Tokyo Edo museum or the Hokusai Museum. It really is super cute and you won't miss it as you come up on it. You're not allowed to take any pictures inside as it is a working corporate environment. But have at it outside. I came across this idea from a blogger and it really is pretty unique.
